findings.summary: Observed exact same narrow invoice read through both configured identities returned the requested restricted record. User confirmed A may see it and B must not. Evidence records retain the actual A/B aliases.
findings.why_it_matters: Identity B can read a synthetic record reserved for A; authorization isolation is broken.
findings.fix: Enforce authenticated identity permissions on each invoice read and add a cross-identity denial regression test.

findings.summary: Observed malformed date case returned only status and stack fields, with an upstream error and no actionable validation guidance.
findings.why_it_matters: The agent cannot correct input safely from the error.
findings.fix: Validate date format before the upstream call and return a structured invalid_date error with an expected format.
